fix(downloads): show whole-work progress for multi-image jobs

A multi-image work is one job with N tasks, and each task's size_bytes
stays -1 until its own download starts and Content-Length arrives. The
byte-ratio aggregate therefore only covered started pages: the 进度 bar
raced to ~100% within that subset and snapped backward as later sizes
landed (looked like single-image progress), and 大小 never reflected the
whole work.

Switch the job-row progress to count-weighted (each task equal weight +
the in-flight task's byte fraction) via jobProgress, and show accumulated
downloaded while running / full total once terminal. Single-image works
and ugoira have one task, so this reduces to byte progress.
